note: The approved keyword map. One primary keyword per page, never shared. The copy (title, description, H1, H2s, first paragraph, FAQ answers) is in content.json; tools/pages/keywords.mjs fails the build when a page breaks these rules. Phrases are matched loosely: small filler words (in, for, a, an, with, to) and plurals are ignored.
research: Autocomplete suggestions from Google, Bing and DuckDuckGo (1,608 requests, English, India). Autocomplete frequency is a proxy for demand, not search volume; the primary keywords are chosen for intent fit and low competition, not for traffic.

rules.title_note: 'title' in these rules is the per-page page title (og:title and twitter:title). The browser-tab title (<title>) is one constant string on every page: content.json seo.tab_title.
